title: Beans'Bee
about.title: About
about.content: Beans'Bee is a small independent video game studio founded in December 2025 by two friends who wish to express their creativity across the gaming world. We aim to offer games with rich universes, unique characters, and humor filled with references to other games and memes.
projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Explore our current prototypes and future game ideas designed for curious players.
projects.item1.title: Pixel Puzzlers
projects.item1.desc: A vibrant puzzle adventure where every level reshapes itself as you solve it.
projects.item2.title: Space Snack
projects.item2.desc: A cozy space-exploration sim with charming aliens, collectible recipes, and arcade flavor.
projects.item3.title: Haunt Hopper
projects.item3.desc: A fast-paced platformer with ghostly shortcuts, retro visuals, and a playful soundtrack.
news.title: News
news.intro: Stay up to date with our latest studio updates and upcoming release windows.
news.item1.content: We are polishing the first demo for Pixel Puzzlers and preparing a community preview in early summer.
news.item2.content: Beans'Bee has expanded with a new artist joining the team to bring even more personality to our worlds.
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.content: Reach out to learn more about Beans'Bee, our projects, or partnership opportunities.
